tasks.label: Verify Node.js runtime
args: $nodeDir = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\nodejs" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; if (-not $nodeDir) { Write-Output 'Node.js user-local folder not found'; exit 2 }; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'node.exe') --version; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') --version

tasks.label: Install project dependencies
args: $nodeDir = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\nodejs" -Directory | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; $env:Path = "$nodeDir;$env:Path"; Set-Location backend; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') ci; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Set-Location ..\client2; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') ci; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Start NeuroNote backend
args: $nodeDir = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\nodejs" -Directory | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; $env:Path = "$nodeDir;$env:Path"; Set-Location backend; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') run start:dev

tasks.label: Start NeuroNote frontend
args: $nodeDir = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\nodejs" -Directory | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; $env:Path = "$nodeDir;$env:Path"; Set-Location client2; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') start

tasks.label: Test authentication screens
args: $nodeDir = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\nodejs" -Directory | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; $env:Path = "$nodeDir;$env:Path"; Set-Location client2; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') test -- --watchAll=false --runInBand

tasks.label: Retest authentication screens
args: $nodeDir = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\nodejs" -Directory | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; $env:Path = "$nodeDir;$env:Path"; Set-Location client2; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') test -- --watchAll=false --runInBand

tasks.label: Build NeuroNote client
args: $nodeDir = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\nodejs" -Directory | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; $env:Path = "$nodeDir;$env:Path"; Set-Location client2; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') run build

tasks.label: Identify API port owner
args: $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 7070 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($listener) { Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = $($listener.OwningProcess)" | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine } else { Write-Output 'Nothing is listening on 7070' }

tasks.label: Inspect processes listening on API port
args: $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 7070 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($listener) { Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId = ' + $listener.OwningProcess) | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine } else { Write-Output 'Nothing is listening on 7070' }

tasks.label: Find process on 7070
args: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 7070 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess | ForEach-Object { Get-Process -Id $_ | Select-Object Id,ProcessName,Path }

tasks.label: Inspect Node API process
args: $pidOnPort = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 7070 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -eq $pidOnPort } | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine

tasks.label: Restart NeuroNote API
args: $nodeDir = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\nodejs" -Directory | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; $env:Path = "$nodeDir;$env:Path"; $pidOnPort = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 7070 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; if ($pidOnPort) { Stop-Process -Id $pidOnPort -Force }; Set-Location backend; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') run start:dev

tasks.label: Check API listener after restart
args: $pidOnPort = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 7070 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; if ($pidOnPort) { Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -eq $pidOnPort } | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine } else { Write-Output 'No listener on 7070' }

tasks.label: List NeuroNote backend processes
args: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'Graduation-project-laith.*backend|backend.*nest start|backend.*dist\\main' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,CommandLine

tasks.label: Inspect Node process tree
args: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object Name -eq 'node.exe' | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,CommandLine

tasks.label: Clear duplicate NeuroNote APIs
args: Stop-Process -Id 15444,10164,2456,10688,17004,4732 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 7070 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalPort,OwningProcess

tasks.label: Start updated NeuroNote backend
args: $nodeDir = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\nodejs" -Directory | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; $env:Path = "$nodeDir;$env:Path"; Set-Location backend; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') run start:dev
